value.quote:
## Cancellation Policy

You may cancel your Subscription Service at any time and for any reason. To cancel, contact patient support at [care@altrx.com](mailto:care@altrx.com) or [+1 607-601-6969](tel:+160****6969) and request cancellation, or cancel through your online account/patient portal (if applicable).

Cancellation requests must be received at least 72 hours prior to your next billing date in order to stop the next charge. If your request is received inside that 72-hour window, your Subscription Service will be charged in accordance with the then-current billing cycle, that charge is non-refundable, and the cancellation will take effect at the start of the subsequent billing cycle.

After cancellation, you will continue to receive the Subscription Services through the end of the then-current paid term. Cancellation does not entitle you to a refund of any amount already paid.

## Multi-Month and Bundled Plans

**MULTI-MONTH AND BUNDLED SUBSCRIPTION PLANS ARE SOLD AS A SINGLE, INDIVISIBLE PURCHASE AND ARE NON-REFUNDABLE IN WHOLE AND IN PART.**

If you purchase a multi-month or bundled plan, you are purchasing the full term at a discounted, bundled rate in exchange for the full-term commitment. No refund or credit will be issued for any unused month, unused service, undelivered or unshipped medication, or remaining portion of the term, and the purchase price will not be prorated or reduced for any reason.

If you cancel a multi-month or bundled plan in a timely manner, the cancellation stops any future renewal of that plan. You retain access to the Subscription Services through the end of the term you purchased, and no portion of the amount paid will be refunded.

## Medical Disqualification

If our healthcare provider determines that you are not clinically eligible for the Subscription Services, your Subscription Service will be canceled and you will be issued a refund for any unused portion of the amount paid for the then-current term. For purposes of this policy, used portions of Subscription Services include costs associated with a live or asynchronous consultation that has taken place; a healthcare provider review of your intake, records, and lab results; issued prescriptions; dispensed or shipped medication; or ordered or performed lab services.

If a medical disqualification occurs, the value of services already rendered will be deducted from your refund, and billing will stop going forward.
